summary: Frontend-only testing for iteration 4 completed on mobile viewport 390x844. All requested features verified: humidificateur guide shows the 3 water choices (déminéralisée / bouteille / robinet) and FAQ has 'Quelle eau mettre dans l'humidificateur ?' with the same choices in the accordion answer. Suivi tab renders ReminderCard with web info text (no crash). /bilan: bilan-start-card, bilan-start-date, bilan-edit-start-button open the start-date-sheet with day/month/year steppers, values capped to today, start-date-save-button persists after reload. Schedule logic correct: start ~10 months ago → chips bilan-period-0 '3 premiers mois', bilan-period-1 'Mois 3 à 9', bilan-period-2 'Mois 9 à 15 (en cours)', next = start+15 months with 'bilan des 6 mois'; start = today → only bilan-period-0 '(en cours)' and next = start+3 months with 'bilan des 3 premiers mois'. Period chip filters bilan-period-range text correctly. Questionnaire result and intro both mention 'à 3 mois, puis tous les 6 mois'. Survey-card bilan button titled 'Mon bilan'. Regression: home, add night (save works, suivi-average updates), entretien screen all OK. No red-screen or runtime errors.

issues: Minor French grammar: 'Du 7 octobre 2026 au aujourd'hui.' reads oddly ('au' + 'aujourd'hui'). Consider "jusqu'à aujourd'hui" or "à ce jour". bilan.tsx:123

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely in src/ui.tsx or theme styles; non-blocking but should migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ web.

action_items: Optional: Fix minor copy in /bilan range text 'au aujourd'hui' → "jusqu'à aujourd'hui" (bilan.tsx line 123).
Optional: Replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow in shared UI components to silence RN Web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: bilan.tsx periods loop guard (i < 40) and clamp of picked index are good; defaultIdx roll-back when <30 days into a new period is a nice UX touch.
start-date clamp uses addMonths(date,-12)/+12 for year nav which can cross month-length boundaries differently than expected on 31-day months; low impact but note.
ReminderCard correctly short-circuits on web via notificationsSupported.
seed_data_creation: None — only used localStorage interactions through UI (set start date, save a night).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Expo web preview at EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL. Use mobile viewport 390x844. Data persists in localStorage; to reset start date, open /bilan → Modifier. ReminderCard native settings (reminder-time-*, reminder-switch-*) only render on native (notificationsSupported false on web). Current date during test: 7 Oct 2026.
